nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Convex hull and Euclidean distance transform helpers for binary masks.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.convex_hull_slicewise
   nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.convex_hull_3d
   nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.distance_transform


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: convex_hull_slicewise(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, axis: int = -1) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Apply a 2D convex hull independently on each slice orthogonal to *axis*.

   Non-zero voxels in each slice are filled to their planar convex hull.


.. py:function:: convex_hull_3d(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Fill the 3D convex hull of all foreground voxels.


.. py:function:: distance_transform(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: Tuple[float, float, float] | None = None, radius_mm: float | None = None) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Euclidean distance transform of the background (outside foreground).

   When *radius_mm* is set, return a binary tube (distance ≤ *radius_mm*).
   Otherwise return float32 distance (mm if *spacing* is provided).
